notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
